create_ModelSlimConfig: create a ModelSlimConfig instance from a quantization config dictionary for diffusion model quantization
get_scheme_for_layer: get the quantization scheme for a linear layer based on layer name and quant description config
get_quant_method_for_layer: get the quantization method for a linear layer, returning UnquantizedLinearMethod if skipped or not a LinearBase
apply_weights_to_tensor: apply quantized forward pass to a tensor using the layer scheme with optional bias
create_quantized_layer_weights: create quantized layer weights using the scheme with input/output sizes and params dtype
